stories.summary: The Asia Future Summit returns on 27 November at Marina Bay Sands, with Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong, Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan and regional leaders discussing Asia's role in a changing global order — just ahead of Singapore assuming the ASEAN chairmanship in 2027.
stories.title: Asia Future Summit 2026: Regional leaders to discuss Asia's role in a changing global order
stories.why: The summit sets the agenda for Singapore's ASEAN chairmanship year.

stories.summary: Alphabet is planning a bond sale of about $3 billion across Hong Kong and Singapore, sources said, as the Google parent taps Asian debt markets.
stories.title: Alphabet eyes $3 billion Hong Kong, Singapore bond sale, sources say
stories.why: A big-name US tech issuer choosing Singapore for a bond sale underlines the city's role as a regional funding hub.

stories.summary: A crew member was tied up during a robbery on a vessel in the Singapore Strait, the piracy reporting centre said, as robbery incidents spike after ten months of decline in one of the world's busiest waterways.
stories.title: Crew member tied up in vessel robbery in Singapore Strait as incidents spike
stories.why: A reversal after months of improvement in strait security — a direct safety concern for shipping through Singapore.

stories.summary: Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after he had two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, people familiar with the matter said. The board planned to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine his future; shares fell about 8% after hours.
stories.title: Nvidia Is Preparing to Oust CEO Jensen Huang
stories.why: The world's most valuable chipmaker faces a leadership crisis with national-security overtones — and Singapore sits at the centre of the diversion allegations.

stories.summary: At a Washington event run by the Special Competitive Studies Project, US officials said quantum computing has reached a 'put up or shut up' moment: Commerce is committing $2 billion with nine companies, and DARPA is moving to the final stage of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative to test whether an industrially useful quantum computer can be built by 2033.
stories.title: Quantum computing hits 'put up or shut up' moment
stories.why: Washington is now testing whether quantum hype survives rigorous benchmarking — with $2 billion and a 2033 target on the line.

stories.summary: Optus has validated Cisco's Live Protect on its 8000 Series routers — a world-first that lets the carrier apply targeted protections to network infrastructure without disrupting services while a permanent software fix is tested.
stories.title: Optus Strengthens Network Resilience with Live Protect Validation
stories.why: A practical fix for the patch-vs-uptime dilemma facing every large network operator.

stories.summary: US stocks leaped and Europe notched a record-high close on Wednesday, as a 20% surge in CoreWeave and a rebound in Nvidia revived the AI trade and outweighed fears the Fed could deliver a 50-basis-point hike in December. The Nasdaq rose 1.6%, the S&P 500 1.3%, and the STOXX 600 closed at a record 663.05.
stories.title: Trading Day: AI cheer banishes rate hike fear
stories.why: The AI trade is again strong enough to override rate-hike fears — for now.

stories.summary: Australian shares opened lower on Thursday, with the S&P/ASX 200 down 0.4% to 9117.9 in early trade as higher yields and a stronger dollar weighed, though tech stocks rallied — Xero surged nearly 10% on its interim result.
stories.title: ASX Opens Lower Amid AI Trade Uncertainty
stories.why: Asia's first read on the AI wobble: broad weakness, but tech holding up on earnings.

stories.summary: The dollar held near a one-month high in early Asian trading, with the dollar index at 102.85 — its highest since 14 October — as traders priced in further Fed hikes after hot October inflation. The yen edged toward the psychologically important 160 per dollar, trading at 159.58.
stories.title: Dollar near one-month high as yen edges toward 160
stories.why: The yen is closing on 160 — the level markets watch for possible intervention.

stories.summary: American and Iranian forces have exchanged strikes around the Strait of Hormuz, with US forces repeatedly bombing Iran's Qeshm Island and Tehran attacking navigation infrastructure on an Omani island, even as President Trump said the war was on hold and the US naval blockade would continue.
stories.title: US And Iran Trade Blows As Trump Claims War Could End Soon
stories.why: Fighting around the world's most important oil chokepoint continues despite talk of a pause.

stories.summary: Saudi Arabia said debris from two ballistic missiles intercepted by its air defences fell in the Mecca region on Wednesday, as the kingdom and Yemen's Houthis exchanged attacks in an escalating conflict that threatens the Bab el-Mandeb Strait shipping route.
stories.title: Saudi Arabia says debris from intercepted missiles falls in Mecca region
stories.why: Missile fire reaching Islam's holiest region marks a sharp escalation in the Saudi–Houthi conflict.

stories.summary: Belgium has ordered NASAMS air-defence systems worth NOK 10 billion (about US$1 billion) from Kongsberg, forming part of its new Blue Dome system alongside 20 Rheinmetall Skyranger short-range systems and Thales radars — a multinational air-defence build-up.
stories.title: Billion-dollar Belgium deal for NASAMS creates multinational air defence system
stories.why: Europe's air-defence shopping spree continues, with Belgium now building a layered national dome.

stories.summary: An Israeli airstrike hit the surgery department at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killing at least five people including a surgeon and wounding 20, Gaza's civil defence said. More than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since last year's ceasefire deal, according to territory health officials.
stories.title: Israeli strike on southern Gaza hospital kills five, Gaza civil defence says
stories.why: A hospital strike deepens the toll of a ceasefire that is fraying on both sides.

tldr: Asia Future Summit returns on 27 Nov with DPM Gan and FM Vivian Balakrishnan, ahead of Singapore taking the ASEAN chair in 2027.
Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs including one with a suspected Chinese spy.
AI cheer lifted US and European stocks to a record STOXX high, brushing off fears of a jumbo Fed hike.
US and Iranian forces traded strikes around the Strait of Hormuz even as Trump said the war was on hold.
